name: Maximum Portfolio Size K
description: Limits maximum number of selected strategies in portfolio (default K = 5).

name: Incompatible Strategy Exclusion
description: Enforces x_i + x_j <= 1 for mutually exclusive or conflicting strategy pairs.

name: Prerequisite Dependency Requirement
description: Enforces x_A <= x_B where strategy A requires prerequisite strategy B.

name: District Eligibility Enforcement
description: Restricts binary decision variables strictly to ELIGIBLE or CONDITIONALLY_ELIGIBLE candidates.
